feature_area: Swag Labs inventory page (https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html): product list item count, price and Add to Cart button per item

e2e_conventions.function_naming: not specified; existing tests use descriptive sentence titles, e.g. 'standard user can log in'
e2e_conventions.test_style: test.describe with test() blocks; assertions via expect(...).toBeVisible() / toHaveURL; import { test, expect } from '../fixtures'
e2e_conventions.selector_priority: locators by id (#user-name, #login-button) and [data-test="error"]; existing InventoryPage uses CSS class (.inventory_list)
e2e_conventions.page_objects_dir: pages/ (BasePage, LoginPage, InventoryPage); locators are private readonly fields on page objects (public readonly only when specs assert on them directly, e.g. inventoryList, errorMessage)
e2e_conventions.architecture_notes: Page Object Model; fixtures/index.ts extends Playwright test to provide loginPage and inventoryPage fixtures; utils/env.ts getCredentials() reads SAUCE_USERNAME / SAUCE_PASSWORD (default public demo credentials); baseURL https://www.saucedemo.com set in playwright.config.ts; BasePage.goto(path) wraps page.goto
e2e_conventions.testing_guidance: locators may need adjusting if the site changes; no dotenv, set credentials via shell variables

framework.ui_run_command: npm test (headed: npm run test:headed; report: npm run report; types: npm run typecheck)
